def regular(path):
    before = os.lstat(path)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode)

                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        raw = b"".join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return raw, {
        "path": path,
        "type": "file",
        "mode": stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
        "uid": after.st_uid,

def directory(path):

    assert stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISDIR(after.st_mode)
        assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return {
        "path": path,
        "type": "dir",
        "mode": stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
        "uid": after.st_uid,
        "gid": after.st_gid,
        "dev": after.st_dev,
        "inode": after.st_ino,
    }

def regular(path):
    before = os.lstat(path)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino)
        chunks = []
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1048576)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        raw = b"".join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return raw, {
        "path": path,
        "type": "file",
        "mode": stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
        "uid": after.st_uid,
        "gid": after.st_gid,
        "dev": after.st_dev,
        "inode": after.st_ino,
        "nlink": after.st_nlink,
        "bytes": len(raw),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    }


def directory(path):
    before = os.lstat(path)
    assert stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISDIR(after.st_mode)
        assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return {
        "path": path,
        "type": "dir",
        "mode": stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
        "uid": after.st_uid,
        "gid": after.st_gid,
        "dev": after.st_dev,
        "inode": after.st_ino,
    }


def tool(path, size, digest):

    assert identity["bytes"] == size and identity["sha256"] == digest
    assert identity["mode"] & 0o111
    return identity
